<script>
"use strict";
const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
const times = [0,160,340,500,680,840,1020,1180,1200];

// Each row follows the same landmarks around the outside of a limb.
const leftSleeves = [

  [41,105,69,110,83,112,84,140,75,162,62,174,48,170,38,157,35,141,37,124],
  [11,121,36,123,59,95,62,112,52,145,39,164,26,169,17,162,13,148,12,135],
  [12,111,36,114,61,88,63,108,52,139,40,159,28,163,19,156,15,143,13,127],
  [47,97,75,102,87,106,86,132,79,152,65,165,50,161,40,149,35,132,39,113],
  [7,101,31,102,57,84,59,102,50,129,38,149,22,152,12,145,9,132,8,115],
  [29,122,58,125,76,115,75,145,69,167,58,180,45,177,34,165,30,151,30,137]
];
const rightSleeves = [
  [195,89,216,85,221,93,225,109,231,127,229,140,219,149,206,152,197,146,192,132,190,109],
  [140,105,164,96,182,81,198,89,209,106,212,127,208,148,194,166,178,166,154,153,144,133],
  [194,102,216,97,223,105,227,119,232,138,229,151,218,160,204,162,195,156,190,140,188,121],
  [169,133,193,119,201,107,211,119,217,135,219,151,215,172,205,185,191,186,176,175,170,157],
  [159,116,183,106,196,94,209,107,218,125,220,144,215,160,202,175,187,176,167,166,160,146],
  [195,98,217,95,222,101,226,117,230,133,228,147,217,157,204,159,196,153,192,140,190,118],
  [152,122,177,111,188,96,203,106,212,122,215,140,211,158,198,174,182,176,162,163,155,146],

const leftTips = [

  [5,66,9,59,19,55,24,59,29,72,31,92,25,96,12,94,7,85],
  [39,103,44,93,54,87,62,90,72,101,79,125,71,126,54,120,43,113],
  [7,106,12,98,23,93,29,96,35,111,41,134,34,136,20,130,12,120],
  [8,99,13,92,22,87,28,90,34,103,38,124,31,126,18,120,12,112],
  [44,90,51,80,61,76,68,79,76,91,82,112,74,113,58,107,47,100],

const rightTips = [

  [168,130,174,117,183,105,190,104,200,114,205,125,197,137,182,145,171,145],
  [158,112,164,99,173,88,180,88,190,99,195,110,187,121,173,130,161,128],
  [196,99,201,85,208,74,214,74,222,83,225,92,218,105,207,113,198,112],
  [152,117,158,104,166,95,175,95,186,105,191,117,182,128,167,134,155,133],
  [192,119,198,105,206,93,214,93,222,101,224,112,217,125,204,135,194,132]
];
// Head displacement, face tilt, torso displacement and chest-light offset.
const posture = [
  [0,0,0,0,0,0],[2,1,12,-1,0,-18],[1,5,0,1,4,-1],
  [0,11,8,-2,11,-15],[1,7,7,-1,7,-13],[0,2,0,0,2,-2],
  [1.5,6,11,-1,6,-16],[1,10,2,1,10,-5]
];
const rightTurn = [[0],[1],[.04],[.82],[.91],[.02],[.96],[.13]];

function outline(points) {
  const count = points.length / 2;
  const coord = (i,axis) => points[2*((i+count)%count)+axis];
  let d = `M${points[0]} ${points[1]}`;
  for (let i=0; i<count; i++) {
    const controls = [];
    for (let axis=0; axis<2; axis++) {
      controls[axis] = coord(i,axis)+(coord(i+1,axis)-coord(i-1,axis))*.15;
      controls[2+axis] = coord(i+1,axis)-(coord(i+2,axis)-coord(i,axis))*.15;
      controls[4+axis] = coord(i+1,axis);
    }
    d += "C"+controls.join(" ");
  }
  return d+"Z";
}

function render(t) {
  const ms = ((t%1200)+1200)%1200;
  let i=0;
  while (ms>=times[i+1]) i++;
  const next=(i+1)%8;
  const u=(ms-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
  const blend=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const sample = table => table[i].map((v,k)=>v+(table[next][k]-v)*blend);
  byId("leftSleeve").setAttribute("d",outline(sample(leftSleeves)));
  byId("rightSleeve").setAttribute("d",outline(sample(rightSleeves)));
  function setPaw(side,table) {
    const points=sample(table);
    byId(side+"-tip").setAttribute("d",outline(points));
    const glint=byId(side+"-glint");
    glint.setAttribute("cx",points[4]-2);
    glint.setAttribute("cy",points[5]+5);
  }
  setPaw("left",leftTips);
  setPaw("right",rightTips);
  const [x,y,tilt,bodyX,bodyY,lightX]=sample(posture);
  byId("head").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${tilt} 124 24)`);
  byId("body").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${bodyX} ${bodyY}) scale(1 ${1-bodyY/245})`);
  byId("belly-light").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${lightX} ${bodyY*.22})`);
  const turn=sample(rightTurn)[0];
  const gold=byId("rightGold");
  gold.setAttribute("x1",.12*turn);
  gold.setAttribute("y1",.48+.52*turn);
  gold.setAttribute("y2",.52-.48*turn);
}
window.nwb={render};
render(0);
